topics.en: Which guerrilla movement was formed by PMA cadets and college students during World War II?
topics.tl: Aling kilusang gerilya ang binuo ng mga kadete ng PMA at estudyante noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig?
topics.ex: The reviewer identifies Hunters ROTC Guerrillas as a PMA cadet and college-student movement against Japanese forces.
topics.exTl: Tinutukoy ng reviewer ang Hunters ROTC Guerrillas bilang kilusan ng mga kadete at estudyanteng lumaban sa mga Hapones.

topics.en: When was Hunters ROTC Guerrillas established?
topics.tl: Kailan itinatag ang Hunters ROTC Guerrillas?
topics.ex: It was organized in January 1942 after military training was halted by war.
topics.exTl: Naorganisa ito noong Enero 1942 matapos ihinto ng digmaan ang pagsasanay-militar.

topics.en: Which location was an Hunters ROTC Guerrillas area of operation?
topics.tl: Aling lugar ang area of operation ng Hunters ROTC Guerrillas?
topics.ex: The reviewer names Parañaque, including Pitong Gatang in San Dionisio, as an Alpha Oscar area.
topics.exTl: Binanggit ng reviewer ang Parañaque, kabilang ang Pitong Gatang sa San Dionisio, bilang Alpha Oscar area.

topics.en: What does Hukbalahap mean?
topics.tl: Ano ang kahulugan ng Hukbalahap?
wrong: Hukbo ng Bansa Laban sa Kastila
wrongTl: Hukbo ng Bansa Laban sa Kastila
topics.ex: Hukbalahap is the shortened name for Hukbong Bayan Laban sa Hapon.
topics.exTl: Ang Hukbalahap ay pinaikling pangalan ng Hukbong Bayan Laban sa Hapon.

topics.en: Where was Hukbalahap founded on March 29, 1942?
topics.tl: Saan itinatag ang Hukbalahap noong Marso 29, 1942?
topics.ex: The reviewer gives Sitio Bawit, Cabiao, Nueva Ecija as its founding location.
topics.exTl: Itinuturo ng reviewer ang Sitio Bawit, Cabiao, Nueva Ecija bilang lugar ng pagkakatatag.

topics.en: In communist symbolism, what does the hammer represent?
topics.tl: Sa simbolismo ng komunismo, ano ang sinasagisag ng martilyo?
topics.ex: The hammer stands for workers; the sickle stands for farmers or peasants.
topics.exTl: Ang martilyo ay para sa manggagawa; ang kumpay ay para sa mga magsasaka.

topics.en: Which five social groups are represented by the red star's points?
topics.tl: Aling limang pangkat ang sinasagisag ng sulok ng pulang bituin?
topics.correct: Workers, farmers, soldiers, intellectuals, and youth
topics.correctTl: Manggagawa, magsasaka, sundalo, intelektwal, at kabataan
wrong: Governors, mayors, judges, police, and teachers
Islands, regions, provinces, cities, and towns
Merchants, priests, nobles, Indios, and slaves
wrongTl: Gobernador, mayor, hukom, pulis, at guro
Pulo, rehiyon, lalawigan, lungsod, at bayan
Mangangalakal, pari, maharlika, Indio, at alipin
topics.ex: The reviewer links the red star to five social groups in communist thought.
topics.exTl: Iniuugnay ng reviewer ang pulang bituin sa limang panlipunang pangkat sa kaisipang komunista.

topics.en: Who was known as Kumander Liwayway?
topics.tl: Sino ang kilala bilang Kumander Liwayway?
topics.ex: Remedios Gomez-Paraiso was a former beauty queen who joined the movement after her father was killed by Japanese troops.
topics.exTl: Si Remedios Gomez-Paraiso ay dating beauty queen na sumapi sa kilusan matapos patayin ng mga Hapones ang kanyang ama.

topics.en: Who was Kumander Dayang-Dayang?
topics.tl: Sino si Kumander Dayang-Dayang?
topics.ex: Felipa Culala was the only woman co-founder and a Military Committee member of Hukbalahap.
topics.exTl: Si Felipa Culala ang kaisa-isang babaeng co-founder at kasapi ng Military Committee ng Hukbalahap.

topics.en: Where did the Battle of Mandili take place?
topics.tl: Saan naganap ang Labanan sa Mandili?
topics.ex: Felipa Culala led the Battle of Mandili in Candaba, Pampanga.
topics.exTl: Pinangunahan ni Felipa Culala ang Labanan sa Mandili sa Candaba, Pampanga.

topics.en: What was Martha Martin's role in the Hukbalahap struggle?
topics.tl: Ano ang papel ni Martha Martin sa pakikibaka ng Hukbalahap?
topics.correct: She fought as a sniper or manunudla
topics.correctTl: Lumaban siya bilang sniper o manunudla
topics.ex: The reviewer describes Martha Martin as a woman Hukbalahap warrior and sniper.
topics.exTl: Inilalarawan ng reviewer si Martha Martin bilang babaeng mandirigma at sniper ng Hukbalahap.

topics.en: What gave Igorot guerrillas an advantage in the Battle of the Pockets?
topics.tl: Ano ang nagbigay ng kalamangan sa mga Igorot sa Labanan sa Pockets?
topics.correct: Knowledge of mountain and forest terrain
topics.ex: Familiarity with mountain and forest routes helped Igorot fighters resist Japanese forces.
topics.exTl: Nakatulong ang kaalaman sa mga lagusan sa kabundukan at kagubatan sa paglaban ng mga Igorot.

topics.en: Which is a guerrilla tactic named in the reviewer?
topics.tl: Alin ang taktikang gerilya na binanggit sa reviewer?
wrongTl: Pagkubkob lamang sa bukas na larangan
topics.ex: The reviewer lists intelligence, sabotage, ambushes, and hit-and-run actions as guerrilla methods.
topics.exTl: Inililista ng reviewer ang intelihensiya, pagsabotahe, pananambang, at salakay-at-takas bilang paraan ng gerilya.

topics.en: What was Polo y Servicio?
topics.tl: Ano ang Polo y Servicio?
topics.correct: Forced labor for Filipino men aged 16 to 60
topics.correctTl: Sapilitang paggawa para sa mga lalaking Pilipino edad 16 hanggang 60
topics.ex: It compelled men to work on roads, bridges, churches, and galleons for little or no pay.
topics.exTl: Pinilit nitong magtrabaho ang mga lalaki sa kalsada, tulay, simbahan, at barkong galyon nang salat ang bayad.

topics.en: Which group was at the lowest level of Spanish social stratification?
topics.tl: Aling pangkat ang nasa pinakamababang antas ng social stratification ng Kastila?
topics.ex: Native Filipinos, called Indios, were treated as the lowest social group.
topics.exTl: Ang mga katutubong Pilipino o Indio ay itinuring na pinakamababang pangkat sa lipunan.

topics.en: Who named the Philippines in 1542 in honor of Felipe II?
topics.tl: Sino ang nagbigay ng pangalang Pilipinas noong 1542 bilang parangal kay Felipe II?
topics.ex: Ruy Lopez de Villalobos named the islands in honor of the future King Felipe II.
topics.exTl: Pinangalanan ni Ruy Lopez de Villalobos ang mga pulo bilang parangal sa magiging Haring Felipe II.

topics.en: What is a Torogan?
topics.tl: Ano ang Torogan?
topics.correct: The traditional family house of Maranao royalty
topics.correctTl: Tradisyonal na pampamilyang bahay ng mga maharlikang Maranao
topics.ex: A Torogan is the traditional dwelling of Maranao royalty, including sultans and datus.
topics.exTl: Ang Torogan ay tradisyonal na tirahan ng mga maharlikang Maranao, kabilang ang sultan at datu.

topics.en: Which group is known for the kalis, barong, and colorful vinta boats?
topics.tl: Aling pangkat ang kilala sa kalis, barong, at makukulay na vinta?
topics.ex: The reviewer describes Tausug as skilled warriors and seafarers, known for these weapons and boats.
topics.exTl: Inilalarawan ng reviewer ang Tausug bilang magigiting na mandirigma at bihasang manlalayag, na kilala sa mga sandata at bangkang ito.

topics.en: What does Binukot refer to?
topics.tl: Ano ang tinutukoy ng Binukot?
topics.correct: Secluded Panay Bukidnon women regarded as culture bearers
topics.correctTl: Mga kababaihang Panay Bukidnon na inililihim at tagapag-ingat ng kultura
topics.ex: Binukot women are respected as guardians of Panay Bukidnon cultural history and art.
topics.exTl: Ang mga Binukot ay iginagalang bilang tagapag-ingat ng kasaysayan at sining ng Panay Bukidnon.

topics.en: What is the traditional meaning of bayanihan in the reviewer?
topics.tl: Ano ang tradisyonal na kahulugan ng bayanihan sa reviewer?
topics.correct: Community cooperation, such as moving a house or planting without expecting payment
topics.correctTl: Pagtutulungan ng pamayanan, tulad ng paglilipat ng bahay o pagtatanim nang walang hinihintay na kapalit
topics.ex: The reviewer presents bayanihan as cooperative community work done without expecting compensation.
topics.exTl: Inilalarawan ng reviewer ang bayanihan bilang pagtutulungang pamayanan na walang hinihintay na kapalit.
